saw_lines: Travelers pick a trip planner once, then open it at every stop, checking visas, eSIMs and maps before each border.
So the sale is won or lost on the first screen, where a visitor decides if the tools are worth it.
Your site leads with a 4.7 rating, so put that number on the first ad you launch and open it with the eSIM and visa tools.
